entities.display_name: A Plain Door, Better Locks Than It Looks

entities._comment: unlike Wilovan/Coyle, none of her effects reference a quest id or a start_combat entity C1 doesn't own (gold/accomplishment only), so the rumor-vending hub + the TALK-path testimony chain's *shape* are safe to ship now
entities.observe: A tea-tray harness worn shiny at the left shoulder — she pours right-handed and listens left-eared. The cups are chipped. The ears are not.
entities.friendly_line: She pours you a cup without being asked. "On the house," she says, "which is the only kind of trade I ever regret."

dialogue.speaker: Cups
dialogue.text: Tea's free. Rumor's a gold the cup.

entities.observe: Two figures loitering with the specific stillness of people about to stop pretending they're not waiting for you.

entities._comment: `alley_footpads_b`, the pair's second placement (east corridor, toward the parlor door).
entities.observe: The second pair, closer to the counting-house door — same trick, same stillness, better light to see it by.

entities.skill_hint_toast: The clean ledger is the tell. Sizing up what is really here takes a practiced read.

on_skill_use.toast: The desk's own ledger reads clean — too clean, the kind of clean a man pays for. Whatever's real is hidden better than this. You'll want to know how this place is watched before you go digging further.

variants.toast: [Appraise Foe] — Now you know the gap in the watch, the true ledger comes easy: tucked behind a false-backed drawer no honest desk needs. Forty gold to a 'removal man,' dated the night before Coyle's own theft: his hand, his numbers, his mistake. The drawer's second catch gives up a shallow hidden safe behind it, empty now but scored where something heavier than coin sat until recently.

entities.locked_toast: The desk's own ledger reads clean, which is exactly the kind of clean a man pays for. You don't have the eye to find the real one. Not yet.

entities._comment: GH#68 (Invrisil quest-stage rework): the SKILL path's Stage 2 gate
entities.skill_hint_toast: Two men keep the counting-house door. Sizing up their rhythm takes a practiced read.

on_skill_use.toast: [Appraise Foe] — Two men on the counting-house door, and they're sloppier than they think: the same slow circuit, the same gap while both backs are turned, near enough on the bell to set a watch by. Time it right and the desk inside is yours for a minute, maybe two.

entities.locked_toast: Two men on the door, pacing something. You don't have the eye to time it yet.

entities._comment: Plain on_interact_accomplishment, no skill gate (a fighter-built PC must never need [Appraise Foe] to reach a fight).
entities.observe: The runner's trail ends at a side door with fresh boot-scuff on the sill and burgundy-and-brass livery moving past the gap in the shutters. Coyle's crew, and no mistaking the building now.
entities.toast: The runner ducks inside, and you finally see the whole of it: crates stacked to the rafters, more of Coyle's livery than a legitimate warehouse ever needs. Wherever the come-along ends, it ends here.

entities._comment: matches combatants.json's own wilovan record + sim_combat_batch.gd's `hired_blades_w10_wilovan`/`hired_blades_w10_solo` harness cells (gated 0.6-0.8 with the ally, measured-only solo).
entities.observe: Three men in burgundy-and-brass doublets, clubs and knives held like men who've used them before. Merchant-livery, not Watch steel — Coyle's, all the way down to the stitching.

entities._comment: R6 (#95) trap placement 1/2: alley_footpads_a leftover, the footpad-era's remnant danger post-safe-passage.
entities.once_per_waking_toast: The stash spot sits empty. Knowing this alley, someone will restock it.
entities.skill_hint_toast: A snag-line at ankle height, tied crate to drainpipe. Old footpad work, the kind meant to trip a running mark. Worth clearing.
entities.locked_toast: A taut line crosses the alley at ankle height, tied off crate to drainpipe. It's clearly meant to trip someone. You can't see how to clear it safely.

on_skill_use.toast: You unhook the line and coil it loose. A couple of coins sit tucked in the crate it was tied to, payment nobody came back to collect.

entities._comment: Avoidable: (11,12)/(13,12) both clear (y12 blocks only x0-7).
entities.once_per_waking_toast: Cleaned out — by you, earlier. The alley keeps its own inventory schedule.
entities.skill_hint_toast: A stack of crates wedged just wrong, top-heavy and set to come down on whoever pulls from the bottom. Old footpad mischief.
entities.locked_toast: The crate stack looks ordinary until you notice the angle: top-heavy, wedged to fall. Pulling from the bottom feels like a very bad idea.

on_skill_use.toast: You brace the stack and ease the wedge free by hand. Behind the bottom crate: a couple of coins someone forgot to collect.

entities._comment: Wave D-1 (#155): the invrisil SATELLITE bench -- entry [Low-Grade Synthesis] only, gives [Mixer] a second region (an apothecary corner off the boulevard). Placed at (1,6), a top-left corner off every QA path (invrisil_walkthrough walks row6 cols3-10 and row7 cols1-10; approach from (1,7)/(0,6)). Placeholder cauldron sprite (VISUAL-LOG). Banks synthesized_draught like every alchemist bench.
entities.skill_hint_toast: A cramped apothecary corner, its burner free for anyone who knows the working. Invrisil rents everything by the hour, including this.
entities.locked_toast: A back-alley apothecary's bench, crowded with someone else's half-finished work. None of it means anything to you.
entities.observe: Shelves of labelled jars, a rented burner, and a hand-lettered card: WORKING SPACE, BY THE HOUR, NO CREDIT.

on_skill_use.toast: [Low-Grade Synthesis] — Someone else's burner, your working. The draught comes out crude but honest, same as anywhere.

entities._comment: GH#142: Hedault, Invrisil enchanter (user placement ruling 2026-07-15). CANON-NATIVE Vol 6-7. Sprite: human placeholder + tint, VISUAL-LOG. No shop -- his commerce is the enchant dialogue.
talk_pool: Appraisal is free to watch and expensive to interrupt.
Do not touch the workbench. Do not touch the wares. Ideally, do not touch anything, including me.
Half this city's 'enchantments' are paint. The other half are apologies. I sell neither.
entities.observe: A severe man at a spotless corner bench, tools laid out at right angles. Everything about him says the prices are exact and the opinions are free.
